lines.japanese:
ちなみに丸目蔵人佐長恵（まるめ・くらんどのすけ・ながよし）は、肥後（現
代の熊本）出身の剣豪で、実在の人物である。
lines.english: Incidentally, Marume Kurandonosuke Nagayoshi was a master swordsman from Higo (present-day Kumamoto) and a real historical figure.

lines.japanese:
天文９年（１５４０）生まれ。
　幼い頃から剣の道に生き、京に出ては新陰流始祖と言われる上泉伊勢守信綱
（かみいずみ・いせのかみ・のぶつな）のもとで修行をした。
　後にはタイ捨流の開祖ともなった、屈指の剣豪である。
lines.english: Born in Tenbun 9 (1540). He devoted his life to swordsmanship from childhood, later traveling to Kyoto to study under Kamiizumi Ise-no-kami Nobutsuna, the reputed founder of Shinkage-ryu. He later founded Taisha-ryu and was one of the foremost masters of the sword.

lines.japanese:
しかし帰郷し九州にて島津との戦に出た蔵人佐は、敵の罠にかかり多くの部下
を死傷させてしまう。
　それは剣の腕ではなく、戦としての判断力における敗北と言えた。
　以降、蔵人佐は零落。９０歳でその生涯を閉じることになる。
lines.english: After returning home, however, Kurandonosuke went to war against the Shimazu in Kyushu and fell into an enemy trap, with many of his men killed or wounded. It was a defeat not of swordsmanship but of judgment on the battlefield. Kurandonosuke fell into decline thereafter. He died at the age of ninety.

lines.japanese: もちろんのことながら、恋とか言わない。
lines.english: Naturally, he never said anything like “love.”
